entities.name: Yehoshua Robert Büchler
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Robert Yehoshua Büchler was a Slovak-Israeli historian. In 1944, he was deported from Slovakia and survived Auschwitz and Buchenwald concentration camps. He was the director of the Moreshet Archive in Israel. Büchler was awarded the Order of Merit of the Free State of Thuringia.

entities.name: Yehoshua Robert Büchler
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Robert Yehoshua Büchler was a Slovak-Israeli historian. In 1944, he was deported from Slovakia and survived Auschwitz and Buchenwald concentration camps. He was the director of the Moreshet Archive in Israel. Büchler was awarded the Order of Merit of the Free State of Thuringia.
